name: Measured ground time-overcurrent
summary: Applies time-overcurrent protection to a separately measured ground or neutral input in the cited Eaton family.
description: Applies time-overcurrent protection to a separately measured ground or neutral input in the cited Eaton family.

The drafting record should connect this function to the dedicated CT input and external ground/neutral sensor, then trace the measured earth-fault timing element and trip circuit. Keep the complete designation and equipment tag together so that the SLD, relay logic and terminal schedule describe the same implementation.

The cited mapping is a public manufacturer example (Eaton ETR family). Suffixes are not universal equivalences across products, and this reference supplies neither a protection setting nor certification of the selected scheme.
readingNotes: Identify the dedicated CT input and external ground/neutral sensor.

drawingChecklist: Label the dedicated CT input and external ground/neutral sensor.
Cross-reference the measured earth-fault timing element and trip circuit.
Retain the complete suffix, selected device tag and manufacturer manual revision.
distinction: A measured ground input can have different sensitivity and CT requirements from calculated residual current.
